description.zh: 从“质数相乘易、分解难”出发，用模算术、欧拉定理与扩展欧几里得算法造出公钥和私钥，演示加密解密对所有明文成立，在浏览器里真实运行试除法看窃听者的成本，并估算现实密钥长度。教科书版 RSA：小质数、无填充，不能用于真实保密。
description.en: Starting from “multiplying primes is easy, factoring is hard”, build public and private keys with modular arithmetic, Euler’s theorem and the extended Euclidean algorithm, show encryption and decryption working for every plaintext, run trial division for real to see the eavesdropper’s cost, and estimate real key lengths. Textbook RSA with tiny primes and no padding — not for real secrecy.

formula: c = m^e mod n,  m = c^d mod n,  e·d ≡ 1 (mod φ(n))

reason.zh: 第 0 步的“乘易分解难”是一种（假设上的）单向性，与哈希函数“正向易、反向难”的思想同类。
reason.en: Step 0’s “easy to multiply, hard to factor” is an (assumed) one-way property, the same idea as hash functions being easy forward and hard to reverse.

label.en: One more digit, ten times the work

reason.zh: 第 0 步的纵轴是对数刻度：试除法的步数随位数指数增长，正是指数与对数页讲的“乘出来是指数”。
reason.en: Step 0’s vertical axis is logarithmic: trial-division work grows exponentially with digits, the “multiplying makes exponentials” of the exp-log page.

title.zh: 为什么公开的锁不会泄露钥匙？
title.en: Why doesn’t a public lock leak the key?
